tools.name: openosint
tools.description: AI-powered OSINT agent with interactive REPL, MCP server, and direct CLI modes.
notes: Direct email and username scans work without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the AI REPL and MCP modes need it, or --api-key.

Other features need their own keys: SHODAN_API_KEY (Shodan), VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY (VirusTotal), CENSYS_API_ID and CENSYS_SECRET (Censys), ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY (AbuseIPDB) and IP2LOCATION_API_KEY (IP2Location).
Bright Data tools need BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY with BRIGHTDATA_SERP_ZONE or BRIGHTDATA_UNLOCKER_ZONE; OPENAI_API_KEY selects the OpenAI provider and OPENOSINT_PROXY_URL sets a proxy.
